response.headline: Anthropic appoints Microsoft veteran Irina Ghose as India MD
response.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic has appointed former Microsoft ​executive Irina Ghose as its ‌managing director for India, the company said ‌on Friday.  Ghose served as managing director for Microsoft's India business, a role she held for two years before ⁠leaving the ‌company in December 2025, following a 24-year career at ‍the U.S. tech major.  Anthropic, which is backed by Alphabet's Google and Amazon, is set ​to open its first India ‌office in Bengaluru in early 2026.

response.headline: Trump Moves to Make Tech Giants Pay for Surging Power Costs
response.summary: The unprecedented plan, set to be announced Friday morning, seeks to address growing tensions over how the nation can supply electricity to power-hungry data centers — seen as necessary to help win the global AI race — without simultaneously hiking utility bills for homes and businesses.  The Trump administration and some US governors plan to direct grid operator PJM Interconnection LLC to hold an auction for tech companies to bid on 15-year contracts for new electricity generation capacity.
